Hi John —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

1) SOC 2 / compliance
   - You asked for our SOC 2 status: Redwood Inference maintains a SOC 2 Type II report and we can provide the redacted report under an NDA or secure transfer. We also have GDPR controls and can discuss HIPAA scoping if required.

2) Vendor security questionnaire (SSQ)
   - You mentioned you'll send an initial SSQ. Once we have it, Marissa will own the intake and return.

3) Private/VPC/on-prem options
   - Options we discussed:
     a) Dedicated VPC peering (customer VPC + Redwood managed control plane)
     b) Private deployment (VPC + customer-managed control plane / air-gapped on-prem appliance)
     c) Fully on-prem / air-gapped package for regulated environments
   - I’ll attach a high-level deployment diagram and a short brief with network isolation patterns and typical diagram legends.

4) Next steps
   - John: share your SSQ (or vendor portal link) and confirm whether HIPAA data flows are in scope.
   - Marissa: will intake the SSQ and coordinate with security/compliance.
   - Marcus (me): share the deployment diagram + brief (attached). Also available for a technical walkthrough next week — propose Tue/Wed afternoon PT.

If that matches your expectations I’ll send the attachments and we can schedule the follow-up.

Thanks,

Marcus Lin
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference

John — attaching the requested artifacts:

- redwood-deployment-vpc-diagram.pdf (high-level topology and options)
- redwood-vpc-security-brief.pdf (network isolation patterns, encryption, key management, and air-gapped deployment notes)

Short answers:
- SOC 2: Redwood is SOC 2 Type II audited. We can provide a redacted report over a secure transfer (or via your vendor portal).
- Air-gapped / on-prem: we do support an air-gapped on-prem package for customers who require zero egress. That typically requires an on-prem appliance + offline installation bundle and an engagement with our infra team. Typical lead time for pilot installs is 6-8 weeks from contract sign-off depending on procurement and access windows.
- Network isolation: diagram shows three patterns — public hosted API (not suitable for regulated data), dedicated VPC with peering and private endpoints, and fully air-gapped on-prem. The brief calls out KMS integrations (customer-managed keys), audit-log forwarding options, and recommended segmentation.

Marissa will own the SSQ response. If helpful I can set a technical deep-dive with our infra lead next week (Tue/Wed afternoon PT).

Attachments: redwood-deployment-vpc-diagram.pdf (PDF), redwood-vpc-security-brief.pdf (PDF)
